Show a custom on-screen toast

Usage: wayle toast [OPTIONS] [LABEL]

Arguments:
  [LABEL]  Toast text. Optional when `--preset` supplies one

Options:
      --icon <ICON>              Icon name shown beside the text
      --percentage <PERCENTAGE>  Progress percentage (0-100); shows a progress bar when set
      --duration <DURATION>      Auto-dismiss duration in milliseconds (toast config default when unset)
      --preset <PRESET>          Preset id from `[[toasts.presets]]` to base this toast on
      --class <CLASS>            Extra CSS class applied to the toast for custom styling
  -h, --help                     Print help
